channel.title: Wildcard Watch: N-able
channel.description: Exploited vulnerabilities and attacks involving N-able, each with its fix status and first step.

item.title: Patch now (update): N-able MailAssure: (SpamExperts) Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
item.description:
N-able MailAssure: SSRF · admin required · internet-facing · exploited · fix: 20261121.1943 · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Update N-able MailAssure to 20261121.1943 or later.

N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the LDAP synchronization connection check that allows an authenticated API user to connect to arbitrary internal hosts and ports, determine which are reachable, and send crafted data to internal services.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-134624

item.title: Patch: N-able zero-day vulnerabilities can lead to full compromise
item.description:
N-able zero-day: exploited · fix available

First step: Install the security update for N-able zero-day. The CCB advisory lists the affected and fixed versions.

The Centre for Cybersecurity Belgium (CCB) warns about this. The CCB advisory lists the affected versions and the fix.

High · Fix available
